name: Mother Hesk
title: Keeper of The Perch

nodes.speaker: npc
nodes.text: Welcome to The Perch, dear. Highest inn in the world, lowest prices on the Landing.

nodes.speaker: npc
nodes.text: Maelis sent you? Sit down, dear, you look like the wind's still in your ears. You want to know about the world? Start with the Cathedrals.

nodes.speaker: npc
nodes.text: Every town down there has one. They're where heroes wake up when they fall. You close your eyes on some battlefield and open them on a cold stone floor, safe and sound.

nodes.speaker: npc
nodes.text: Nobody ever asks how the Benefactor knows exactly where you fell. Or why he's so keen to have you back on your feet.

nodes.speaker: npc
nodes.text: Don't look at me like that. I'm just an old woman who runs the highest inn in the world. Off you go, back to Maelis.

chatter: Kettle's on, if you want it.
You've got that new-arrival look about you.
Ask questions, child. Nobody up here asks enough of them.
